_note: Single source of truth for every metrics.py threshold. Calibrate visual.pass_threshold by eye against backend/dataset_analysis/metrics_report/<brand>/index.html - see CLAUDE.md 'Metrics' and GATE 1. Never tune a threshold just to make the pass rate look better; change the underlying metric or say the number is what it is.

visual.pass_threshold_note: UNCALIBRATED DEFAULT - a starting guess, not yet confirmed by eye. See GATE 1.

cluster.cluster_margin_note: bbox-proximity union-find margin for grouping nearby leaf shapes into one logical cluster - same technique as derive_brand_rules.cluster(), tuned there against dalmia's real logos (see CLAUDE.md 'Designer dataset analysis').

layout.min_text_pt_note: Real data, not a guess: every text font size across all 13 cached dalmia real files ranges 80.7-300pt (large-format signage read from a distance, not desktop print). 40pt is a floor comfortably below the smallest real value - keep in sync with app/layout.py's MIN_TEXT_PT, which the text-fit shrink loop also uses.
layout.full_bleed_note: A cluster is exempted from the min_margin check (only that check - it still counts for within_page/overlap) if its bbox spans (within page_tolerance_mm of) the full page width or height, or its area is >= this fraction of the page - both signal a deliberate edge-to-edge design element (e.g. a full-width accent rule line, or the true background), not a misplaced object. Found via GATE 1 feedback: every dalmia board flagged a spurious 0.0mm margin from exactly this kind of full-width strip.
